basic_info.description: Welcome to 3122 Clay, a dreamy 2-level condominium in the heart of one of San Francisco's most beloved neighborhoods, Pacific Heights. This home boasts the incredibly rare attribute for a condominium: 4 bedrooms and 3 baths. Coupled with a generous layout including a living room, dining room and two family rooms, the lifestyle on this tree lined block is fantastic. The Victorian architecture allows for 10 foot ceilings, oak floors, wainscoting and bay windows. The proverbial cherry on top is the walkout, exclusive use garden which is award winning and published in magazines. Within walking distance you will find yourself at the Presidio Library, Alta Plaza Park, Fillmore St, Sacramento St and Laurel Village. Come and experience it for yourself.
